description: Raft node grants votes without checking candidate log up-to-dateness (§5.4.1), electing stale leaders that lose committed state.
spec_notes: RaftNode.handle_request_vote must verify candidate's last_log_term and last_log_index before granting vote.

"""Raft log entry definition."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class LogEntry:
    index: int
    term: int
    command: Any

"""Raft RPC request and response payloads."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, List
from log_entry import LogEntry


@dataclass
class RequestVoteArgs:
    term: int
    candidate_id: str
    last_log_index: int
    last_log_term: int


@dataclass
class RequestVoteReply:
    term: int
    vote_granted: bool

tests.test_raft_election.py:
from log_entry import LogEntry
from raft_node import RaftNode
from rpc import RequestVoteArgs


def test_vote_granted_when_candidate_up_to_date():
    node = RaftNode("n1")
    node.current_term = 1
    node.log = [LogEntry(1, 1, "cmd1")]
    args = RequestVoteArgs(term=2, candidate_id="cand_2", last_log_index=1, last_log_term=1)
    reply = node.handle_request_vote(args)
    assert reply.vote_granted is True
    assert node.voted_for == "cand_2"


def test_vote_denied_when_candidate_log_term_is_stale():
    node = RaftNode("n2")
    node.current_term = 3
    node.log = [LogEntry(1, 1, "c1"), LogEntry(2, 3, "c2")]
    # Candidate has term 4 (higher term), but last_log_term is 2 (< node term 3)
    args = RequestVoteArgs(term=4, candidate_id="stale_cand", last_log_index=5, last_log_term=2)
    reply = node.handle_request_vote(args)
    # Stale candidate MUST NOT be granted vote!
    assert reply.vote_granted is False
    assert node.voted_for is None


def test_vote_denied_when_candidate_log_shorter_at_same_term():
    node = RaftNode("n3")
    node.current_term = 2
    node.log = [LogEntry(1, 1, "c1"), LogEntry(2, 2, "c2"), LogEntry(3, 2, "c3")]
    # Candidate has last_log_index 2 at term 2 (node has index 3 at term 2)
    args = RequestVoteArgs(term=3, candidate_id="shorter_cand", last_log_index=2, last_log_term=2)
    reply = node.handle_request_vote(args)
    assert reply.vote_granted is False
